changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: create or alter procedure [graph].[Hop_LoadHopHierarchies] @hopSalt varchar(25), @direction char(1), @hopNumber int as begin insert into #nodes ([Level], [Position], AssetUid, AssetID, [Key], ParentID, ParentKey, Back, Fore, Icon, AssetTypeID, AssetTypeUid, Class, DisplayValue, Reveal, ActionCount, RelationCounts, UseAsTransformation, IsLeaf, Parsed, IsFocal) select doc.c.value('level', 'int') as [Level] ,doc.c.value('position', 'int') as [Position] ,A.Uid as AssetUid ,doc.c.value('assetId', 'bigint') as AssetID ,case when L.[Key] is not null and A.Uid = L.AssetUid and doc.c.value('leaf', 'bit') = 1 then L.[Key] else utility.GetHash(@hopSalt + '|' + cast(A.ID as varchar(50)) + '|' + cast( doc.c.value('level', 'int') * doc.c.value('position', 'int') as varchar ) ) end as [Key] ,doc.c.value('parentAssetId', 'bigint') as ParentID ,iif( doc.c.value('parentAssetId', 'bigint') = 0, null, utility.GetHash(@hopSalt + '|' + doc.c.value('parentAssetId', 'varchar(50)') + '|' + cast( doc.c.value('parentLevel', 'int') * doc.c.value('parentPosition', 'int') as varchar ) ) ) as [ParentKey] ,A.BackColor as Back ,A.ForeColor as Fore ,A.Icon ,coalesce(A.AssetTypeID, doc.c.value('assetTypeId', 'int')) as AssetTypeID ,A.AssetTypeUid ,A.AssetTypeClass as Class ,doc.c.value('value', 'nvarchar(250)') as DisplayValue ,0 as Reveal ,0 as ActionCount ,'[]' as RelationCounts ,0 as UseAsTransformation ,case when doc.c.value('leaf', 'bit') = 1 then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as IsLeaf ,0 as Parsed ,L.IsFocal from #links L inner join graph.AssetNode N on N.Uid = L.AssetUid cross apply N.ReformattedSegments.nodes('/path/segment') doc(c) inner join AssetWithType A on A.ID = doc.c.value('assetId', 'bigint') where L.Direction = @direction and L.HopNumber = @hopNumber; end
changeSet.rollback:
create or alter procedure [graph].[Hop_LoadHopHierarchies] @hopSalt varchar(25), @direction char(1), @hopNumber int as begin with cte as ( select Segment.query(' <path> { let $segments := (/path/segment) for $x in $segments return <segment> <position>{data($x/@position)}</position> <level>{data($x/@level)}</level> <assetTypeId>{data($x/@assetTypeId)}</assetTypeId> <assetId>{data($x/@assetId)}</assetId> <parentLevel>{data(/path/segment[. << $x][last()]/@level)}</parentLevel> <parentPosition>{data(/path/segment[. << $x][last()]/@position)}</parentPosition> <parentAssetId>{data(/path/segment[. << $x][last()]/@assetId)}</parentAssetId> <value>{data($x)}</value> <leaf>{$x is $segments[last()]}</leaf> </segment> } </path> ') as Segment, [Key], AssetUid, IsFocal from #links where Direction = @direction and HopNumber = @hopNumber )
insert into #nodes ([Level], [Position], AssetUid, AssetID, [Key], ParentID, ParentKey, Back, Fore, Icon, AssetTypeID, AssetTypeUid, Class, DisplayValue, Reveal, ActionCount, RelationCounts, UseAsTransformation, IsLeaf, Parsed, IsFocal) select distinct doc.c.value('(level/text())[1]', 'int') as [Level] ,doc.c.value('(position/text())[1]', 'int') as [Position] ,A.Uid as AssetUid ,doc.c.value('(assetId/text())[1]', 'bigint') as AssetID ,case when T.[Key] is not null and A.Uid = T.AssetUid and doc.c.value('(leaf/text())[1]', 'nvarchar(1)') = 't' then T.[Key] else utility.GetHash(@hopSalt + '|' + cast(A.ID as varchar(50)) + '|' + cast( doc.c.value('(level/text())[1]', 'int') * doc.c.value('(position/text())[1]', 'int') as varchar ) ) end as [Key] ,doc.c.value('(parentAssetId/text())[1]', 'bigint') as ParentID ,utility.GetHash( @hopSalt + '|' + doc.c.value('(parentAssetId/text())[1]', 'varchar(50)') + '|' + cast( doc.c.value('(parentLevel/text())[1]', 'int') * doc.c.value('(parentPosition/text())[1]', 'int') as varchar ) ) as [ParentKey] ,A.BackColor as Back ,A.ForeColor as Fore ,A.Icon ,coalesce(A.AssetTypeID, doc.c.value('(assetTypeId/text())[1]', 'int')) as AssetTypeID ,A.AssetTypeUid ,A.AssetTypeClass as Class ,doc.c.value('(value/text())[1]', 'nvarchar(250)') as DisplayValue ,0 as Reveal ,0 as ActionCount ,'[]' as RelationCounts ,0 as UseAsTransformation ,case when doc.c.value('(leaf/text())[1]', 'nvarchar(1)') = 't' then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as IsLeaf ,0 as Parsed ,T.IsFocal from cte T cross apply T.Segment.nodes('/path/segment') doc(c) inner join AssetWithType A on A.ID = doc.c.value('(assetId/text())[1]', 'bigint'); end
